en: A tinted historic postcard showing a wooden railway station building with a red roof and several dormer windows. A steam locomotive with carriages stands at the platform on the left, while many people in early 20th‑century clothing wait or walk along the platform. The station name board reads "NYKÖPING". There is printed red text at the top describing the location, and smaller printed text under it, all in Swedish.
